title: Chibinda Ilunga marries a Lunda princess
description: In the Lunda genesis story the Luba hunter Chibinda Ilunga brings the Luba model of statecraft to the peoples of the upper Congo and Luapula.

title: Livingstone dies at Chitambo
description: David Livingstone dies searching for the sources of the Nile, and his men carry his body eleven months to the coast; his heart stays under a mvula tree.

title: Mineral rights concessions
description: Cecil Rhodes's agents obtain mineral concessions from local chiefs, putting the region into the British South Africa Company's orbit.

title: Colonial Office takes over
description: The company's charter lapses and Northern Rhodesia becomes a British protectorate with its capital at Livingstone.

title: Copper discovered
description: Enormous ore bodies are proved along the Congo border, creating the Copperbelt and the mining economy on which the country still runs.

title: Copperbelt strike
description: African mineworkers down tools over taxes and conditions and are shot by police, the first great urban labour action in the colony.

title: Capital moves to Lusaka
description: The administration leaves Livingstone for the more central rail junction of Lusaka.

title: African majority elected
description: Elections give Africans a majority in the legislative council and Kaunda's UNIP and Nkumbula's ANC form an uneasy coalition.

title: Independence
description: Northern Rhodesia becomes the Republic of Zambia with Kenneth Kaunda as its first president.

title: Lusaka summit
description: Zambia hosts the Non-Aligned Movement's summit and Kaunda serves as the movement's chairman.

title: One-party state
description: All parties but Kaunda's UNIP are banned, later written into the constitution as the Second Republic.

title: Rhodesia raids ZIPRA bases
description: The Rhodesian air force attacks guerrilla camps near Lusaka in revenge for the downing of a civilian Viscount, dragging Zambia deeper into the liberation war.

title: Food riots
description: Riots over soaring maize prices leave at least thirty dead in Lusaka and the Copperbelt, breaking UNIP's hold.

title: Coup attempt
description: A junior officer briefly claims power on the radio in the capital but the coup collapses within hours.

title: Multiparty elections
description: Frederick Chiluba's Movement for Multi-Party Democracy thrashes UNIP, and Kaunda hands over power, one of Africa's first democratic transitions.

title: Captain Solo's coup attempt
description: Army captain Steven Lungu announces a government takeover on national radio; loyal troops capture him within hours.

title: Third-term bid fails
description: Huge public protests force President Chiluba to drop his attempt to change the constitution for a third term, and Levy Mwanawasa wins a disputed election.

title: Mwanawasa dies
description: President Levy Mwanawasa dies in Paris two months after a stroke; Rupiah Banda wins the election to succeed him.

title: Sata wins
description: Michael Sata's Patriotic Front wins power from the MMD, only the country's second change of ruling party since 1964.

title: Sata dies
description: Michael Sata dies in London after months of illness; his vice-president Guy Scott, born to Scottish parents, briefly acts as head of state.

title: Lungu wins
description: Edgar Lungu wins the tight by-election to complete Sata's term.

title: Lungu re-elected
description: Lungu narrowly beats Hakainde Hichilema in the first round of a violent general election.
